source.description:
## PROBLEM
Specialists currently starts Pi with --no-extensions and reconstructs a hardcoded extension set in two separate spawn paths. The approved design and native Pi probes show that execution.extensions can instead select path/npm/git sources and each enabled source can be forwarded as one explicit -e argument, but the runtime, package artifact, update path, and clean-machine evidence do not yet implement or prove that outcome.

## SUCCESS
A released-candidate Specialists build forwards configured sources identically through PiAgentSession and direct script/serve execution, preserves user overrides across package update, loads Service Knowledge from its standalone package, and passes unit, integration, packed-artifact, local xt build, isolated-install, upgrade, and clean-machine smoke gates. Publication remains a separately approved irreversible action after reviewer PASS.

## SCOPE
/home/dawid/dev/specialists runtime/schema/loader/config/docs/tests/dist/release artifacts; Core's existing local RC pack/install/update smoke surfaces and design document; local isolated HOME/prefix/container validation using packed artifacts.

## NON_GOALS
- No custom extension package resolver or separate extensions.json.
- No Core Pi bundle growth or arbitrary vendoring.
- No npm publish, tag, or force-push without explicit operator confirmation after all pre-release gates.
- No rewrite of Pi or xt interactive ambient extension discovery.

## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: high. Base Specialists work on exact origin/master 79dbecc82789e8cbc02b733c50cd4c7d867043e1; do not inherit the dirty local checkout or unmerged acc7e163. PiAgentSession impact is HIGH (8 direct, 182 depth-3); applyOverrideFields impact is CRITICAL (15 processes), so tests must precede implementation and preserve legacy gitnexus/serena semantics. No new dependency. Log only ordered configured source identifiers; never prompts, credentials, or environment values. Publication is operator-only.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Focused schema/loader/runner/session/script-runner tests pass.
- [ ] Full Specialists lint, test, build, package payload, and attestation gates pass.
- [ ] Both Pi spawn paths produce identical repeated -e ordering and remote-source offline behavior.
- [ ] Packed Specialists artifact installs over v3.21.5 in an isolated prefix and preserves ~/.config/specialists/user.json extension fields.
- [ ] Local packed xt + Specialists artifacts pass existing installed-artifact/update suite and clean-machine/container smoke or an evidenced equivalent.
- [ ] Security auditor and reviewer PASS on cumulative release candidate.
- [ ] Post-publication latest install/update smoke is planned but not executed before explicit approval.

## OUTPUT
Cross-repo completion report with commits/PRs, artifact versions and hashes, exact pass/fail counts, local build/install/update commands, smoke artifact paths, security/reviewer verdicts, publish decision, and any residual platform limitations.

## REFERENCES
Core design commit 21fa05cc, packages/pi-extensions/docs/specialist-extension-injection-design.md. Native probes: xtrm-qejmp. Recent state: Core PR #607 and Specialists PR #271 are latest merged surfaces; Specialists origin/master is 79dbecc8.
